Title: Add log-derived health charts for error trends, latency, and throughput.
Description: The health workbench already charts memory activity, but it does not visualize structured application logs. Extend the operational surface with log-derived metrics such as errors by day, warnings by subsystem, request latency distributions (p50/p95/p99), throughput, and recent failure bursts so operators can spot regressions without exporting raw files first. Acceptance criteria: at least one health-page chart and one summary panel are derived from structured application logs, latency and throughput are first-class metrics, aggregation windows are configurable from the existing admin configuration, and empty-state behavior is explicit when logs are unavailable. Validation: seed representative informational, warning, error, and high-latency events, verify charts/summary panels show expected counts and percentile buckets, and confirm chart window/threshold settings can be changed in admin configuration without code changes.

Comments.Author: AgentSmith
Comments.Body: Evidence: `MemorySmith.App/Components/Pages/HealthStats.razor` already charts queries and memory changes, but the review found no chart or summary driven by structured application log events, error counts, or correlation-aware failure trends.
